risk_note: RV2 by path (payout), no migration, no contract change, no money moves, one behavioural line (withdraw lane, model Claude Fable 5.1; orchestrator rulings D10-702 ③, D10-707 ②, D10-775, D10-777). The admin 【立即查询】 on a withdrawal waiting for a person (or returned by W9) enqueued its query job under a key carrying a random request id, so every click with another idempotency key, or by another admin, got a job of its own: one out_biz_no was queried concurrently and each job recorded an attempt (B2-09s review S2). The key is now `{withdrawal_id}:{execute_seq}:manual`; queue `payout` is exclusive, so while a job of that key is created / retry / active another send is dropped silently by the queue's unique index (the request transaction is not aborted), and once the job is completed or failed for good the next click enqueues again. Unchanged: the answer submitted, one payout_query_request audit per click, replay of the same idempotency key, only-query-never-resend (BR-WDR-14), the query result as evidence without a transition or a voucher (BR-WDR-15), the consumer's claim per manual_request_id. Real risks: a key that never frees (covered: completed and failed-for-good release it, retry and active hold it — states moved on pgboss.job and proven by the next send), a wider dedupe than intended (covered: another withdrawal and the next execute_seq enqueue their own), a lost audit for the dropped click (covered). Two frozen B2-09s tests pinned the old behaviour (one job per request) and change under D10-777 per D10-327, nothing else in their files: [AC-B2-09s#14] queue 2 → 1 for another key while the first job is queued (audits stay 2); [AC-B2-09s#39] two coexisting jobs → the second click is enqueued only after the first job is completed. The premise was run before the ledger change: with the one line applied, 74 of the 76 tests of the four frozen directories using the endpoint stayed green and exactly these two went red. Not covered by a rule test (spec-test S2s): the W9-returned branch (same key in the code), and a lock-harness proof that the two concurrent clicks of [AC-B2-09y#2] overlap. Codex is out of quota until 2026-11-11 (approvals 36, D10-775): rule tests and reviews are a fresh independent Claude's and recorded as such. Test-machine full verify not run (AWS runners disabled, D10-555; CI verify-int is the full verification, approvals 21); the red run and the implementation's runs were made in the local Docker container / host slot (implementation tree: manual-query-dedupe 6, admin-unknown-payouts 42, unknown-list-row 6, w10-late-paid 12, w10-voucher-crosscheck 16 — 82 green).
